funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants

amount.raw: Small, up to £2,000; Large, from £2,001 to £6,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage; applicant must be the author or editor of the proposed publication, with a publisher confirmed and publication date within three years.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals to disseminate research on British art through publication of monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles, covering costs such as image licensing, subventions, contributor fees and translation.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed; one Research Project Grant per organisation per round.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for organisations undertaking ambitious and sustained research projects in the field of British art, primarily supporting staff costs towards facilitation of a research project with public-facing outcomes and/or legacy.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Exhibition Publication Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit; the exhibition on which the publication is based can be forthcoming or already held.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to produce publications related to their exhibitions and displays, disseminating research on British art, covering practical publishing costs such as image and production costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Event Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to disseminate research on British art through live, online and hybrid events for a variety of audiences, covering costs such as venue hire, accommodation for speakers and staffing.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking a conservation research project or technical analysis; items must be in public or charitable ownership and accessible to the public.
opportunities.summary: Support to protect and preserve significant works of British art by funding original and needed conservation research, covering staff costs and equipment.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Digitisation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking work to digitise items and material in their own collections.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to make their collections freely available online via digitisation of photographic, archival, bound volumes, objects, paintings, publications or other British art assets.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: ERBA Research Travel Bursaries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of Emerging Researchers in British Art (ERBA); those with pending membership may apply.
opportunities.summary: Micro-grants for ERBA members to support a specific research trip (travel, accommodation, reasonable expenses) to visit a library, archive, collection or site, or to meet a key contact or attend a relevant event, to be used between November 2026 and April 2027.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage for lower tiers; £8,001-£20,000 tier available to individuals at postdoctoral level or equivalent research experience or above. Open to international applicants.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for individuals to undertake research travel and/or research time to address specific research questions in British art, covering travel, accommodation, subsistence, staff replacement or daily rates and supporting costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals enrolled to start (with a place confirmed) or already undertaking a master's-level or doctoral-level degree in British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals beginning or continuing a master's-level or doctoral-level degree in British art who may face barriers in undertaking their course of study.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered students at undergraduate level and above, from any country.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for registered students to undertake research trips to examine historical works on paper (prints, drawings, watercolours) from the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries firsthand.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship

amount.raw: total of £32,000 for one year or split over two years if part-time

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of an offer of a master's degree (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) place at a UK-based institution, due to begin between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a master's-level degree in British art that will bring new perspectives to understanding of British art, as part of the New Narratives scheme.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: total of £96,000 awarded as £32,000 a year for three years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of an offer of a doctorate at a UK-based university, starting between April 2027 and April 2028, who have not yet begun their doctorate. International applicants may apply but the amount is fixed.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support doctoral research in British art, paying university fees with the remainder for living expenses, as part of the New Narratives scheme to increase diversity of perspectives.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: one year at £35,000, or two years at £70,000 (£35,000 per year)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at postdoctoral level (or with equivalent experience) or above.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals to undertake an in-depth research project that will reshape understanding of British art, as part of the New Narratives scheme.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship

amount.raw: Full board and accommodation at the British School at Rome for three months, as well as an honorarium

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree, from pre-doctoral PhD candidates to those internationally recognised in their field.
opportunities.summary: A three-month residency at the British School at Rome for individuals undertaking advanced research on cultural contact, exchange and influence between Britain and Italy, providing full board and accommodation plus an honorarium.
